استقضينا (form X)
# اِسْتَقْضَيْنَا (istaqḍaynā) /is.taq.dˤaj.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِسْتَقْضَى (istaqḍā)
# اُسْتُقْضِينَا (ustuqḍīnā) /us.tuq.dˤiː.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِسْتَقْضَى (istaqḍā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
